subject: US-275: Memory Attachments Database Schema
description:
# US-275: Memory Attachments Database Schema

## Objective
Create database schema for memory attachments to support file attachments to memory tokens.

## Technical Tasks
- Create Alembic migration for memory_attachments table
- Define SQLAlchemy model class
- Add foreign key relationship to memory_tokens
- Add indexes for performance
- Add constraints (type check, not null)

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Migration created and tested
- [ ] Model class defined with relationships
- [ ] Indexes created for performance
- [ ] Foreign key constraints enforced
- [ ] Type check constraint working

## Dependencies
- SPEC-001: Core Memory System
- Database migration system (Alembic)

## Estimated Effort
4-6 hours (0.5-0.75 days)

subject: US-276: Memory Attachment Upload Endpoint
description:
# US-276: Memory Attachment Upload Endpoint

## Objective
Implement POST endpoint to upload and attach files to memory tokens.

## Technical Tasks
- Create POST /memory/{memory_id}/attachments endpoint
- Handle multipart/form-data file uploads
- Integrate with storage backend (EPIC#022)
- Validate file type and size
- Store attachment metadata in database
- Generate pre-signed URLs
- Apply ACL permission checks

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Endpoint accepts multipart file uploads
- [ ] Files stored in S3/MinIO
- [ ] Metadata stored in database
- [ ] File validation working
- [ ] ACL checks enforced
- [ ] Proper error handling
- [ ] Unit and integration tests

## Dependencies
- EPIC#022: Storage backend (US#295)
- SPEC-008: Security middleware
- SPEC-043: ACL engine
- US-275: Database schema

## Estimated Effort
12-16 hours (1.5-2 days)

subject: US-277: Memory Attachment Retrieval Endpoints
description:

subject: US-278: Memory Attachment Deletion Endpoint
description:

subject: US-279: File Type Validation and Size Limits
description:
# US-279: File Type Validation and Size Limits

## Objective
Implement comprehensive file validation including type checking, size limits, and security validation.

## Technical Tasks
- Implement MIME type whitelist validation
- Add magic number validation
- Enforce size limits per file type
- Integrate with SPEC-008 security middleware
- Add virus scanning integration (if available)

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] MIME type whitelist enforced
- [ ] Magic number validation working
- [ ] Size limits enforced
- [ ] Masquerading files detected
- [ ] Clear error messages
- [ ] Unit tests for validation
- [ ] Integration tests

## Dependencies
- SPEC-008: Security middleware
- EPIC#022: File upload infrastructure

## Estimated Effort
8-12 hours (1-1.5 days)

subject: US-280: ACL Integration for Memory Attachments
description:
# US-280: ACL Integration for Memory Attachments

## Objective
Integrate SPEC-043 ACL engine with memory attachment endpoints to enforce access control.

## Technical Tasks
- Apply ACL checks to all attachment endpoints
- Use SPEC-043 ACL engine for permission evaluation
- Enforce READ permission for retrieval
- Enforce WRITE permission for upload/delete
- Support user/team/organization scoping

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] ACL checks applied to all endpoints
- [ ] READ permission required for retrieval
- [ ] WRITE permission required for upload/delete
- [ ] Team member access working
- [ ] Organization-level access working
- [ ] Proper 403 errors
- [ ] Unit and integration tests

## Dependencies
- SPEC-043: ACL engine
- Memory ownership model

## Estimated Effort
6-8 hours (0.75-1 day)

subject: US-281: Memory Attachment UI Components
description:
# US-281: Memory Attachment UI Components

## Objective
Create frontend UI components for uploading, viewing, and managing memory attachments.

## Technical Tasks
- Create AttachmentUpload component
- Create AttachmentPreview components (PDF, image, video, code)
- Create AttachmentList component
- Integrate with memory view/edit pages
- Add drag-and-drop file upload
- Show upload progress

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Upload component functional
- [ ] Preview components for all types
- [ ] List component displays attachments
- [ ] Drag-and-drop working
- [ ] Upload progress visible
- [ ] Error handling in UI
- [ ] Responsive design
- [ ] Unit tests

## Dependencies
- Backend API endpoints (US-276, US-277, US-278)
- Frontend framework

## Estimated Effort
16-24 hours (2-3 days)

subject: US-283: MCP Integration for Memory Attachments
description:
# US-283: MCP Integration for Memory Attachments

## Objective
Integrate memory attachments into MCP responses to enable AI access to attachment content.

## Technical Tasks
- Include attachment metadata in MCP responses
- Add file summaries or inline snippets
- Implement memory score boost for attachments
- Support inline parsed contents (OCR, PDF to text)

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Attachment metadata included in MCP responses
- [ ] Memory score boost working
- [ ] File summaries included (if implemented)
- [ ] Integration tested
- [ ] Performance impact acceptable

## Dependencies
- Backend API endpoints (US-277)
- MCP API implementation
- Optional: OCR/PDF parsing libraries

## Estimated Effort
12-16 hours (1.5-2 days)
